## Gold price in September 2018: common questions

Figures in this section are shown in USD, independent of the currency selected above.

### How did gold perform in September 2018?

Gold finished September 2018 at $1,191.50 per troy ounce, having fallen $8.80 (0.73%) over the month. It has traded between $1,182.30 and $1,206.20 across 19 trading days.

### What was the average gold price in September 2018?

The average gold closing price in September 2018 was $1,196.71 per troy ounce, calculated across all 19 trading days in the month.

### What was the highest gold price in September 2018?

Gold reached its highest close of September 2018 at $1,206.20 per troy ounce on 20 September 2018.

### What was the lowest gold price in September 2018?

The lowest gold close in September 2018 was $1,182.30 per troy ounce on 27 September 2018.

### Did gold go up or down in September 2018?

Gold fell during September 2018. It entered the month at $1,200.30 and closed at $1,191.50, a change of -0.73%.

### How many days did gold rise in September 2018?

Gold closed higher on 10 sessions and lower on 9 during September 2018. The strongest session was 28 September 2018 (+0.78%) and the weakest 27 September 2018 (-0.98%).

### How volatile was gold in September 2018?

Daily closes in September 2018 varied with a standard deviation of 0.51% per session, and the peak-to-trough spread across the month was 2.0% ($1,182.30 to $1,206.20).

### What was the gold price per gram and per kilo in September 2018?

At the September 2018 close of $1,191.50 per troy ounce, gold worked out at about $38.31 per gram and $38,307.61 per kilogram. A troy ounce is 31.1034768 grams.

### What was the gold to silver ratio in September 2018?

The gold-to-silver ratio averaged about 84.4 through September 2018 and finished the month near 81.5. A higher ratio means silver is cheap relative to gold.

### How does September 2018 compare with the same period a year earlier?

Gold was around $1,281.50 per troy ounce twelve months before the end of September 2018. Closing at $1,191.50 makes that a decline of 7.0% year on year.
